name: Harriet “Hattie” Michel (Simons, Davison)
notable_stories: C-005: 1900 Census: Harriet Simons, age 41, birthplace Canada → birth ~1858-59 (consistent with canonical Dec 1858).
1910 Census: Hattie Simons, age 59 → birth ~1851 (CONFLICT with 1900 census calculation). Death index conflict.
Noted as 'closest relative' on Raymond Zell Simons' WWI draft card.
milestones: Buried in Lynden Cemetery, Lynden, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
Find a Grave, memorial 6661061 (via Ancestry.com, U.S., Find a Grave Index)
notes: Birth date Dec 1858 newly established — previously excluded as nickname-only. Mother of Raymond Zell Simons.

OPEN QUESTION: John's memoir states Gertrude Elaine Adams Remy was named after 'Beryl's grandmother.' Harriet M. Hattie Simons is one of Beryl's two grandmothers (paternal). If she carried 'Gertrude' as a middle or alternate name, Trudy's naming is explained. Research: Harriet's full name on marriage/birth records.
Date conflict: 1900 census gives birth ~1858-59; 1910 census gives ~1851. Canonical holds Dec 1858 per prior source.
CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Removed simons_glen from children; he is her grandson (son of Raymond Zell Simons).
Unconfirmed: Harriet M. Simons, 41, appears in the 1900 census with Aaron; the record lists an arrival year of 1862, perhaps her family's move from Canada. [Family research emails, email 50]
Unconfirmed: Hattie Simons appears aged 59 in the 1910 census, born in Canada (English). [Family research emails, email 50]

Open question: Hattie Simons's age is 41 in 1900, 59 in 1910 and 62 in 1920, which is inconsistent with a Dec 1858 birth; Irma wonders who gave the census information [Family research emails, email 41, 50]
Open question: The 1900 census 'Arrival 1862' for the Simons household is unexplained. Irma wonders if it marks Hattie's family moving from Canada [Family research emails, email 50]

Born 23 Dec 1858 at London, Ontario; died 14 Jan 1933 at Delta, Whatcom County. Her Find a Grave memorial gives her name as Hattie Michel Davison; her son Ray's death record gives her birth surname as Micheals. The "M." in "Harriet M." (1900 census) may be her birth surname.
After Aaron's death in 1923 she married a Davison, whose first name is not recorded.
Her own parents are not yet known. John Howard Adams said Irma's Ancestry trees contain "a couple of errors", not yet specified. [Family research emails, email 46]
